Each hour thereafter, a Control Resistance save must be made to avoid a temporarily loss of 1 Will Force point. If a Will Force point is lost, a separate Will Force save is required or a random (or GM chosen) form of insanity is applied. While not in possession of a physical form, normal Will Force recovery (1 per hour) is suppressed. When a being reaches 0 Will Force, it dies.
